mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cr.id) AS observation_course_count, COUNT(br.id) AS behavior_record_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN br.detail_saved = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS abc_record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(cr.overall_remark), '') IS NOT NULL THEN cr.id ELSE NULL END) AS remark_count FROM class_record cr LEFT JOIN behavior_record br ON br.class_record_id = cr.id WHERE cr.student_id = #{studentId} AND cr.record_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
